summary: EPOG-JM is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in economic policy, coordinated by Université de Technologie de Compiègne with Sorbonne, CNAM, Turin, HWR Berlin, Roma Tre, Geneva, the University of the Witwatersrand, WU Vienna and two Brazilian universities. Year one is in Turin, Berlin, Rome, Geneva, Vienna, Johannesburg or Rio and Campinas; year two is in Paris. Scholarships pay tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month. Apply by 27 January 2027 at 13:00 Paris time.
meta_title: EPOG 2027: Erasmus Mundus economic policy master's scholarship
meta_description: EPOG-JM pays tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month for an economic policy master's from Turin, Berlin, Johannesburg or Rio to Paris. Apply by 27 January 2027.
covers: A complete tuition waiver, with health and accident insurance.
€1,400 a month during both academic years.
Non-scholarship students pay €9,600 a year, or €1,000 a year if their personal income is below €26,400.
eligibility: Applicants of every nationality, with no more than 10% of scholarships to one nationality.
A bachelor's of at least 180 ECTS in economics, or in any field with at least 24 ECTS in economics and 6 ECTS in statistics or econometrics.
English at C1: TOEFL iBT 95, IELTS Academic 7.0, PTE Academic 67, or Cambridge CAE or CPE. No test is needed if your degree was taught entirely in English.
how_to_apply: Choose a major and minor: Turin; Berlin, Rome or Geneva with Paris; or Turin, Berlin, Vienna or Rio and Campinas with Johannesburg or Paris.
Apply on application.epog.eu with your CV, diploma, transcripts, English proof (or a sworn statement), a statement of purpose of up to 500 words, two recommendation letters and your passport.
Submit by 27 January 2027 at 13:00 Paris time. Interviews are in March and results at the end of March 2027.
watch_out: English proof can follow until 10 June, but a strong application has it from the start.
Applicants from Sub-Saharan Africa, including Ghana and Nigeria, fall in a targeted region that the programme lists for extra scholarships.
Students without a scholarship can ask for an Eiffel scholarship for the Paris year or a DAAD grant for the Berlin tracks.
costs: You, unless your degree was taught in English
documents: Statement of purpose, up to 500 words

faq.a: 27 January 2027 at 13:00 Paris time, for the 2027–2029 cohort.

faq.q: Do I need an economics degree for EPOG?
faq.a: Not necessarily: any bachelor's of 180 ECTS with at least 24 ECTS in economics and 6 in statistics or econometrics qualifies.

faq.q: Does an English-taught degree count for EPOG?
faq.a: Yes. No English test is needed if your higher education degree was taught entirely in English.
